generic_comparator_calibration.note: Generic generative planning comparator only; final V9 sizing must be rerun after exact V9/V1.7 evaluator semantics are frozen.

joint_decision_rule_simulated.note: This is planning logic, not the final frozen V9 evaluator.
joint_decision_rule_simulated.overall: candidate-minus-comparator mean log-loss delta must meet prespecified minimum benefit and one-sided 95% t-UCB < 0
joint_decision_rule_simulated.pass_requires: overall AND all six topology gates simultaneously
joint_decision_rule_simulated.standard_error: two-way voter/challenge cluster approximation; t reference uses conservative cluster degrees of freedom
joint_decision_rule_simulated.topology: all six topology candidate-minus-comparator one-sided 95% t-UCB values must be below the tested NI margin

planning_scenarios.good_min: true mean candidate advantage about 0.020 log-loss with prespecified 0.005 topology heterogeneity SD
planning_scenarios.good_mod: true mean candidate advantage about 0.050 log-loss with prespecified 0.010 topology heterogeneity SD
planning_scenarios.null: candidate and comparator have equal generative expected loss
planning_scenarios.unsafe: one topology is truly worse by +0.020 while the other five are better by -0.040; unsafe topology cycles across all six

required_next_scientific_step: Review this design envelope, then preregister/freeze the exact scale-coherent V9 candidate architecture, exact V1.7 comparator semantics, nuisance fitting, final gates/margins, and one fresh design. After that freeze, rerun final simulation using the exact frozen V9 evaluator before generating any fresh V9 voting catalog.
